result.title: Milano Living
result.description:
Insta360 X4 Air
1066 images from 360 video
Spirula, 1.500.000 Splat
First-ever attempt using photogrammetry. Default camera settings.

Although the lighting conditions are unfavorable, the reconstruction seems good to me, with no floaters; however, the resolution could be improved. I will try using different settings. If you have any tips, please feel free to share them.
